Tests for {@link PosixParser} that override base-class cases unsupported by this parser.

The base class {@code AbstractParserTestCase#testDoubleDash2} verifies that when "--" appears after an option that requires an argument (e.g. {@code -n -- -m}), the parser throws {@link MissingArgumentException} because "--" ends option processing before {@code -n} receives its value. {@link PosixParser} does not implement this behaviour, so the test is disabled here.

Disabled because {@link PosixParser} does not treat "--" as a terminator that triggers {@link MissingArgumentException} when a preceding option still awaits its argument. The base-class assertion ({@code assertThrows(MissingArgumentException.class, ...)}) would fail against this parser.
